privacy.title: Before you start
privacy.subtitle: Privacy notice · Law 18-07
privacy.heading: What Minhajna keeps, and where
privacy.intro: A short notice before first use, always available in Help.
privacy.phoneText: Lists, roll calls, marks and record books are stored encrypted on the device. No account or internet is needed.
privacy.leaveTitle: Nothing leaves unless you send or save it
privacy.leaveText: This version does not connect to the internet, and does not ask for permission to. Pupils’ data never goes into the phone’s cloud backups.
privacy.neverText: No health, disability, religion or photos of pupils, no information about parents, and no addresses. An absence is excused or not, with no reason given.
privacy.trackingText: No ads, no analytics, no record of hours or location. Crash reports stay off unless you turn them on in “Help and privacy”, and none leaves unless you send it.
privacy.publisherText: The open-source Minhajna project. This version connects to none of its servers.
privacy.rightsText: To see what the project holds about you, and to have it corrected and deleted within 10 days.

pc.phoneText: Lists, roll calls, marks and record books are stored encrypted in this browser, with a key sealed under your passphrase. No account is needed, and once installed the app opens without internet.
pc.leaveText: The app comes from https://minhajna.djazair.dev, served by Cloudflare, which sees this PC’s IP address and browser at each visit and each update check. The project keeps no access logs, and nothing you record is sent. Clearing this site’s data in the browser deletes it, so keep a backup.
pc.publisherText: The open-source Minhajna project, which serves this app’s files. It receives nothing you record.

connections.title: What the app connects to, and why
connections.none: This version does not connect to the internet: it asks for no permission to, and sends and receives nothing.
connections.source: The source code link in Licences opens only after you confirm. Your browser opens it outside the app, with no record or identifier.
connections.packSource: A pack’s source address, in its details, opens only after you are asked, and the question names the site. Your browser opens it outside the app, with no record or identifier.
connections.errorReport: A plan-error report is shown in full, and leaves the phone only when you share it and pick the app that sends it. The app adds nothing about your classes or pupils, nor your name unless you type it.
connections.problemReport: The problem report is shown in full, with pupils' names as your class lists write them replaced, and leaves the phone only when you choose to share it and the app that sends it. It holds the version, Android's version and the names of the last screens opened, without their content.
connections.register: Any connection the project adds is listed in the NETWORK.md file of the source code, with what is sent and why, before it reaches the app.
connections.crashReport: The crash report, if you turned crash reports on, is shown in full at the next start and leaves the phone only when you choose “Send” and the app that sends it. It holds the error's type, where it happened in the code, the version, Android's version and the names of the last screens opened, without the error's message or any content.

pc.none: This app connects only to its own address, https://minhajna.djazair.dev: for its files until they are installed, and at each opening, when online, to look for a newer version, which installs only if you accept it. Cloudflare serves it and sees this PC’s IP address and browser; the project keeps no access logs. Nothing you record is sent.
pc.errorReport: A plan-error report is shown in full, and leaves this PC only when you choose to share it: through the browser’s share menu, or copied for you to paste where it has none. The app adds nothing about your classes or pupils, nor your name unless you type it.
pc.problemReport: The problem report is shown in full, with pupils’ names as your class lists write them replaced, and leaves this PC only when you choose to share it: through the browser’s share menu, or copied for you to paste where it has none. It holds the version and the names of the last screens opened, without their content.
pc.crashReport: The crash report, if you turned crash reports on, is shown in full at the next start and leaves this PC only when you choose “Send”. It holds the error’s type, where it happened in the code, the version and the names of the last screens opened, without the error’s message or any content.

mine.open: My classes in the school’s space
mine.subtitle: {{date}} · as the director sees them
mine.noTerm: No term falls on this date, so nothing is counted.
mine.noCalendar: The school has no calendar in this world, so nothing is counted.
mine.plan: Plan progress and the threshold day come with a plan pack.
mine.noWeek: No week of this class is signed this term yet.
mine.foot: “Awaiting confirmation” is not an absence, and it is never printed and never leaves the screen. The space keeps no day on which a session was confirmed, no ranking, no colours for people and no clock times.

report.title: Term report
report.subtitle: {{date}} · the term so far, as the director sees it
report.noCourse: No week is signed this term yet, so the report is empty.
report.makeUps: Make-up sessions: none in a demo world. Outside one they come from the make-ups on “Today” and count as held.
report.foot: Each class has its own figures: no total for the school and no ranking. The report closes when the term does. “Other” gathers everything the calendar does not hold, without reasons: the reasons stay on your devices alone.

records.readOnly: Read only: the director changes no signed week or correction, and sees nothing that does not enter the school’s space.
records.none: No week is signed yet on the channels of the school’s teachers.
records.signed: Signed electronically with the teacher’s certified key, and not corrected since.
records.signedFixed: Signed electronically with the teacher’s certified key; signed corrections: {{count}}.
records.chainWhole: The chain is whole: every version from the original to the last correction was read and its signature checked.
records.chainGap: The chain has a gap, not read: {{versions}}. Only what was read is shown.
records.visaLead: A comment added to the signed week that never changes it. The teacher sees it in their weekly digest, their access log in a demo world.
records.visaDemo: In a demo world a visa shows as given in the school’s space, without proof that the director gave it.
records.visaGiveFix: Give the visa on the correction
records.visaDone: The visa is given, and the week stays as signed.
records.visaAlready: This version already had a visa.
records.visaEarly: No visa before the week’s first day in the world’s date.
records.asSigned: The week is shown as signed. A session not held shows without its reason, and no day of signing, correcting or confirming is kept.
records.noRoll: No roll call or marks in a demo world: the signed week holds each session’s state alone.
records.paper: The paper visa on the texts book stays until the Ministry’s text says otherwise.

hidden.reasons: Why a session was not held
hidden.before: The record before the week is signed
hidden.days: The day of signing, correcting or confirming, its time and place
hidden.others: How many corrections the teacher made in other weeks
hidden.ranks: Any ranking or comparison of teachers

cover.lead: The day’s cover, kept on this PC alone: the teachers never see it, and no reason or absence is kept.
cover.noVersion: No published timetable is in force on this day: the day’s sessions come from the version in force.
cover.noSessions: No session in the version in force on this day.
cover.lastOfDay: The class’s last session of the day
cover.release: Only the class’s last session of the day lets the pupils go; at any other, they stay in the school.
cover.noneFree: No teacher of the staff list is free at this time.
cover.notFree: {{name}} is no longer free at this time: choose again.
cover.sheetNone: No session is marked for cover today.
cover.sheetNever: The sheet never says who was away, or why.
cover.sheetWorld: Outside a world it is printed or sent to the supervisors. A world has no supervisors and exports none of its records, so it stays on screen.
cover.noTerm: The world’s date falls between terms: no cover is counted.
cover.decides: It counts the cover each person gave, to share it fairly. The app suggests; the director decides.
cover.makeups: Make-ups are linked to the sessions they replace and come with Today’s make-ups outside a world; a world has none. Any effect of a missed session on pay is settled in the official channel, not here.
cover.problem: The cover was not kept. Try again.

ttImport.lead: Minhajna imports the timetable and never builds it.
ttImport.fetLine: The timetable file in CSV, as FET exports it.
ttImport.templateLine: The school’s template, saved from Excel as CSV UTF-8: one row for each weekly session.
ttImport.handLine: One weekly session at a time, checked as you type it.
ttImport.handReady: No clash with the sessions entered.

handClash.room: The room is already taken by {{class}} then (entry {{with}})

ttImport.unreadable: The file could not be read. If it comes from Excel, save it as CSV UTF-8.
ttImport.clean: No clash between teachers, classes or rooms.
ttImport.problems: Rows left out of the import
ttImport.refused: The file was not imported: its header could not be read.
ttImport.otherSource: If the file comes from the other source, choose it and open the file again.
ttImport.noSessions: No session was read from the file.
ttImport.gridLater: Checking each class’s hours against the official grid, and each subject’s free half-day, comes when the reference data carries them.
ttImport.weeksNone: No session alternates between weeks A and B.
ttImport.weeksBalanced: Weeks A and B are balanced for every group of pupils and every teacher.
ttImport.weeksUneven: Weeks A and B differ for:
ttImport.weeksKept: The balance counts the imported sessions only, not the rows left out.
ttImport.together: Sessions shared by several classes, to check
ttImport.groupsLine: If one is wrong, rename the set in FET and export again.

problem.order: The end comes before the start
problem.teacher: The teacher is in two places at once, with row {{with}}
problem.class: The class is in two places at once, with row {{with}}
problem.room: The room has two sessions at once, with row {{with}}

lines.cem: Class, teacher and room grids, with the official header and boxes for the director’s and the education counsellor’s signatures.
lines.lycee: Class, teacher and room grids, with the official header and boxes for the director’s and the deputy head’s (censeur’s) signatures.

said.failed: The grids could not be printed or saved. Try again.

ttPrint.directorate: Directorate of Education of the Wilaya of {{wilaya}}
ttPrint.weeks: Weeks A and B alternate: a session marked week A or B takes place in that week only.
ttPrint.demo: Demo world: made-up data, not an official document

ttSend.title: Send each teacher their timetable
ttSend.noCode: Given no code or key yet, so not sent:
ttSend.notStaff: Not in the school’s list of teachers, so not sent:
ttSend.tooLong: Too long to send, or with a name too long:
ttSend.again: A new version is checked first, and replaces only the parts it changes.
ttSend.twoNames: Two or more teachers of the list share this name, so not sent:

ttVersion.line: Check what this timetable changes, then publish it: only the teachers whose sessions change, and those who have none yet, are sent their part, signed by this device.
ttVersion.title: Timetable · version {{version}}
ttVersion.first: The first version: each teacher with a code or key receives their part.
ttVersion.from: Drafted from version {{version}}, the latest standing version.
ttVersion.nothing: Nothing changed in any teacher’s sessions.
ttVersion.recorded: Sessions recorded before {{day}} are not rewritten.
ttVersion.unkept: Sessions this version cannot keep, their names too long or not a session’s shape: {{sessions}}
ttVersion.onceFirst: A version for one day needs a standing version first for every teacher it changes.
ttVersion.unchanged: Teachers told nothing, their sessions unchanged: {{teachers}}

ttProposal.title: Teachers’ proposals
ttProposal.line: A teacher proposes moving one session of their part. The first decision settles it, and the teacher is told either way.
ttProposal.none: No proposal is waiting for a decision.
ttProposal.noVersion: No version is published yet: teachers propose changes once they have their part.
ttProposal.gone: This session is no longer in the standing version, so the proposal can only be declined.
ttProposal.checks: Checked against the whole standing version
ttProposal.teacherFree: No clash for {{teacher}} at the new time.
ttProposal.teacherBusy: {{teacher}} already teaches at the new time.
ttProposal.classFree: {{class}} is free at the new time.
ttProposal.classBusy: {{class}} already has a session at the new time.
ttProposal.roomFree: Room {{room}} is free at the new time.
ttProposal.roomBusy: Room {{room}} is taken at the new time.
ttProposal.hoursChanged: The session’s length changes, and with it {{class}}’s hours.
ttProposal.weekBoth: A weekly session: it moves in both weeks.
ttProposal.weekA: A week A session: it moves in week A only.
ttProposal.weekB: A week B session: it moves in week B only.
ttProposal.cannot: The move clashes, changes the hours or splits a joint session, so it can only be declined.
ttProposal.told: From {{day}}, the change is sent to {{teacher}}, and to any teacher still missing their part; the others hear nothing.
ttProposal.reply: A note sent with the decision
ttProposal.accepted: Accepted: version {{version}} publishes the move, and the decision is sent to {{teacher}}.
ttProposal.declined: Declined: the decision is sent to {{teacher}}, and the timetable is unchanged.
ttProposal.decided: This proposal is no longer waiting: it was settled in the meantime.
ttProposal.refused: This move cannot be accepted. Look for the proposals again.
ttProposal.recordLine: Version {{version}} already holds this move: the acceptance is still to record.
ttProposal.publishedLine: The standing version already holds this move, but in no part this device can vouch for: recording it sends the teacher a new part when theirs lacks the move, and declining leaves the move published.
ttProposal.readAgain: A timetable read before this decision still has the old slot: read it again before publishing from it.
ttProposal.joint: The session is taught to several classes together: moving this class alone would split it.
ttProposal.roomDropped: The proposal gives no room, so the session would lose room {{room}}.

ttReceipt.title: Receipts of the timetable
ttReceipt.line: Each part sent is confirmed from the phone that received it, in place of signing the paper notice.
ttReceipt.none: No teacher has been sent a part yet.
ttReceipt.found: Teachers sent a part on their phone: {{teachers}}. Up to date with every version that applies now or later: {{confirmed}}.
ttReceipt.behind: Version {{sent}} not confirmed yet; version {{version}} confirmed on {{day}}
ttReceipt.keys: Teachers who joined with a security key: {{keys}}. Confirming from the staffroom PC is not in the demo yet.
ttReceipt.dayWaiting: For {{date}} only: version {{version}} not confirmed yet
ttReceipt.newCode: A teacher given a new code is listed once a part is sent with it.
